title: AI-augmented software acceleration: The current frontier of enterprise value delivery
summary: The enterprise software landscape is undergoing a profound transformation. AI-augmented software acceleration isn’t just about building software faster; it’s about reimagining how value is deployed across the organization. Enterprises that strategically integrate AI into their development frameworks are seeing unprecedented gains in speed, agility and cost efficiency—all while unlocking new opportunities for customization, governance and security.
